Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a lawsuit regarding YouTube, Meta and several other companies. YouTube lost it's case when it came to the jury and court discussing the way it handles it's algorithm regarding younger people. How will this shape the Internet going forward? Let's find out! title: YouTube Just Lost A Huge Lawsuit...
